svg.title: Under-2000 upstairs Version B: Version A plus unfinished attic storage over the garage
svg.desc: Version B furnished preliminary diagram: the Version A rooms plus unfinished attic storage. Dashed purple ground-floor garage wall centerlines show partial garage coverage by most of the laundry, the east part of Bath 4 and the mechanical room, not bedroom interiors. An unfinished, unconditioned attic storage room about 11 by 25 feet extends east over the north garage, entered from the furnace room; it is excluded from finished square footage and would be counted if finished or conditioned. South of it the garage keeps its roof. Bedroom 3 and Bedroom 4 lose eighteen inches of front depth; Bedroom 4 also loses 8.4 inches of east width to align its wall with the garage west wall. Bedroom 3 is 12.5 by 11.5 feet clear; Bedroom 4 is 12.15 by 11.5 feet. Their full beds, desks, chairs and nightstands remain full size and are repositioned. Closet 4 is 5.5 by 4.5 feet clear, retaining five feet of hanging and 3.3 feet of shelves, with a door swinging into the bedroom. Four bedrooms, four bathrooms and the shared open gallery remain. Bath 2 stays east at nine by five feet, Closet 2 west at 5.3 by 7 feet. Laundry remains 13.425 by 8 feet with wraparound counters and a 45.3-inch counter aisle before handles. Primary closet keeps three-wall storage and bath-only access. Mechanical remains a six by five-foot provisional furnace/service reservation. Exterior-face gross area including walls and descending stairs, less the actual stair gap, is 1,985.7792 square feet, 14.2208 below 2,000. Products, occupied routes, simultaneous door and appliance operation, storage capacity, HVAC installation and garage fire separation remain unverified. The existing garage roof is not evidence of usable upstairs headroom; roof redesign, load-bearing floor and structure require professional review. Version A (version-a.svg) matches the local 3D trial.
svg.text: Version B: Version A + unfinished attic storage over the garage

Version B adds attic storage over the garage
About 11 ft x 25 ft (~293 sq ft gross) over the north garage, beside Bedroom 2 / laundry / furnace.
Door from the furnace room, which also serves equipment access.
Upper wall lines up with the garage's east wall, so the second-floor mass reads continuous outside.
Kept unfinished and unconditioned, so not counted in the 1,985.78 sq ft.
If drywalled, finished, heated or cooled later it becomes counted living area (~2,280 sq ft).
Assessors may still add minor value for unfinished space; confirm with the county assessor.
Floor framing over the garage span, roof/headroom and garage fire separation need professional review.

svg.text: Generic study footprints, not selected products. Static fit is not occupied-use approval; door swings, fixture spacing and storage capacity need review.
Over-garage floor, roof/headroom, fire separation, HVAC and plumbing require professional review. This diagram does not approve construction.
